notes: Game Bot V0.07: on PCs with only an AMD card, Game Bot starts Ollama with Vulkan so the AI runs on the GPU (NVIDIA cards keep using CUDA), with a safe 8192 context on 8 GB AMD cards. Sci-fi games with no sci-fi environment pack get sci-fi stand-ins (metal floor and wall panels, crates, glowing light strips, cool sky) instead of trees and houses, and the chat names a pack that would look better. Early Access is still NVIDIA-only.
